One more callout, เสริมรับจันทัน 2C-100x50x20x3.2, points at a single solid line near grid 1. Roofing หลังคามุงกระเบื้องลอน... (not structural, not recorded).

Truss segments are split at the supports drawn on the S-05 truss elevations (T1: A, B, D; T2: 2, 3; T3: 1, 2, 3; T4: B', E). Top-chord overhangs to the eave are their own segments (1.00 from this sheet's chains), flagged top_chord_only. Member sections of the trusses are on S-05 (section file).

Hips and the valley are diagonal: span left unresolved (section 4 Span). Where a hip meets the ridge at a point no dimension positions (about x 2.80 and x 4.20 on B', from the 45-degree geometry), the end is written as an approximate ref (~) instead of inventing a dummy line.
T1's dash-dot line on this plan continues from D to E (meeting T2), but the TRUSS T1 elevation only covers A to D. The D-E piece is recorded from the plan with low confidence.
Rafters and purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2); counts left null (rafters are cut by the hips into pieces, purlins only drawn in the cut-away).
